fields.name: MapToSql*Attribute mapping contract
fields.contract: MapToSql*Attribute is a family of property-mapping attributes. Each variant fixes one SQL Server target type and accepts a logical parameter-or-column name. Its constructor dimensions are the target type plus isRequired; string and binary variants additionally retain length, non-Unicode text variants retain localeId, and Decimal additionally retains precision and scale. A variant exposes its accepted CLR type predicate and contributes the configured value to input parameters, output parameters, output-value reads, and data-reader reads under normalized parameter and column names. It also contributes table-valued-parameter rows except MapToSqlJsonAttribute, whose table-valued-parameter operation is unsupported.
